items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: So Cliff Dudley was in the band.

ctx.x:
So Cliff Dudley was in the band.
So anyway, we were just talking and Muse was over by himself and I noticed a policeman saying something to Muse. So after a while Muse reached in his pocket and pulled out a billfold. I figured maybe he was showing him an I.D. So Muse just paused a while and the policeman left. So eventually Muse came over to our little huddle and he said, Ernie, did you see that policeman talking to me? I said yeah, what the hell did he want? He said he acted like he was crazy. I said, what do…

There's the band over there, standing there. If you're here when I come back, I'm going to bag every one of you; that ain't no job for a nigger. So I said, my goodness, and I wondered what to do. It looked like something just told me, I found the station manager and told him what they had told this young man and he said he's right, this is city property, but I tell you what, you won't have long, it's almost train time, you'll be one of the first on and you'll be sure to get your seat. Bring your bags and things…
